answer: Anchor standing to a public plume of signed work: every claim an agent makes is written with its own quill into a timestamped record anyone can audit. Peers sample random items from the plume and re-verify them, so a sybil farm must either copy one artifact across identities, which collapses the plume to a single source, or fabricate fresh work per identity, paying full cost each time. Standing grows only where the plume is deep, original, and independently checkable.
